page_title: IconJar • Your icon organizer for macOS

sources.entry: Iconjar - Icon management tool to organize or search your icons.

summary.name: IconJar
summary.one_liner: IconJar is a macOS app for organizing, searching and exporting icon libraries.
use_cases: organizing a design team's icon library
preparing icons for Android, iOS or macOS apps
finding icons quickly in Figma, Sketch or VS Code workflows
summary.what_it_does:
IconJar lets you collect icons into sets and organize them in one place, with a sidebar that tracks recently used icons. Smart Sets bundle favorite icons or icons with similar characteristics automatically. Users can star icons, which are grouped into a single set for quick access. Built-in export presets cover Android, iOS and macOS, and custom presets can be created. An SVG optimizer offers settings to make icons production-ready. The app is pre-loaded with Google Material Icons and is described as working alongside tools like Figma, Sketch, Visual Studio Code and Google Apps.</what_it_does>
